title: Identity principles — portrait arrangement

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Reorganize an explanatory system for a narrow frame so a viewer can still compare its ingredients without shrinking everything into one row.
strategic_value: A two-column portrait arrangement can keep Audi’s principles legible on a tall display.
demonstration: Eight animated principle tiles form four rows on black: moving presence/rings, colors/icons, imagery/proportions and typography/logo ending.
practical_value: Compare this portrait reflow with the landscape arrangement AU05.

content_islands.name: Top pair
content_islands.spec: Place moving presence beside the ring-placement example.

content_islands.name: Middle pairs
content_islands.spec: Stack palette and icons above imagery and proportions.

content_islands.name: Bottom pair
content_islands.spec: Close with flexible typography and the animated logo ending, retaining captions beneath each tile.

reference_purposes.Expression: The tiles demonstrate ring placement, typography, color, imagery and motion.
reference_purposes.Application: The source supplies this portrait version alongside a differently arranged landscape version.
reference_purposes.Intent: Accompanying KMS prose explains that simplified ingredients and overarching principles enable flexible but consistent communication.

ingredient.name: Principle-based identity ingredients
ingredient.role: Keep varied expressions recognizable without one fixed composition.
ingredient.application: Compare ring placement, flexible type, color, imagery and proportions as coordinated choices. The source explicitly allows free logo placement and describes equally weighted brand colors; it does not mandate identical color area in every composition.
ingredient.scope: Historical KMS TEAM Audi case study; portrait and landscape overviews of the same system, not a complete current Audi manual.
